name: devagent
description: A Claude Code plugin that runs development through a fixed 22-step issue workflow with on-disk state preservation, across GitHub/GitLab/JIRA.

plugins.name: devagent
plugins.description: Drives 55 slash commands over a 22-step issue workflow, preserving all state on disk so you can switch issues without losing context. Works against GitHub/GitLab/JIRA, with capture + issue red-team, revision, WBS, and status-report subsystems.
